title: Cartier smoothness over an arbitrary field of characteristic zero
statement: Let $k$ be a field of characteristic zero [def-weil-field] and let $G$ be a group scheme over $k$ [def-sc-group-scheme], locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Then $G\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ is smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] and $G$ is reduced [def-pc-reduced-scheme]. No affineness, quasi-compactness or commutativity hypothesis is imposed.
